# paper/

Source for the persona-coinflip paper: **"Assistant Bias on the User Turn: Replicating and Extending the PSM Coin-Flip Diagnostic"**, prepared for the BlackboxNLP 2026 special reproducibility track (ACL format, double-blind review mode).

**Status: real data.** All figures are generated by `make_figures.py` from analyzer outputs in `results/` (no placeholder data; the old placeholder pipeline is gone). Numbers in captions and Limitations were audited against the analyzer JSON/markdown on 2026-07-08, with a second cold-read audit pass on 2026-07-09.

## Files

- `paper.tex` — the paper. Compiled with `\usepackage[review]{acl}` (anonymous + line numbers); drop `review` for camera-ready.
- `acl.sty`, `acl_natbib.bst` — ACL style files (vendored).
- `references.bib` — citations; real author lists, no commentary notes. Every key is cited and every citation resolves (checked both directions).
- `figures/` — PNGs regenerated via `python3 paper/make_figures.py` (header of that script maps each figure to its `results/*.json` source), except the two persona-drift figures (`persona_drift_open.png`, `persona_drift_plaintext.png`), which come from `python3 src/analyze_drift.py --mode <mode> --plot` and are copied in from `results/`.
- `paper_writing_checklist.md` — Nanda paper-writing checklist with anchored ticks; §13 holds project-specific rules (zero numbers in abstract/intro, no prose numbers duplicating figures, phenomenon-first framing, citation hygiene, harmful-stimuli discipline, anonymity).
- `walkthrough.md` — informal narrative walkthrough of the experiments (not part of the submission).

## To compile

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/paperbuild
cd paper
tectonic -o /tmp/paperbuild paper.tex
```

Tectonic fetches LaTeX dependencies on first run. Body (through Conclusion) must end within 6 pages; Limitations, Ethics, references, and appendices are exempt under the ACL policy.

## Before submission / camera-ready

- Re-run the §13 checks in `paper_writing_checklist.md` (two items are deliberately open: colorblind-palette verification and the final sentence-level pass).
- Camera-ready: remove `review` option, restore author block, and swap the anonymity footnote for the real code/dataset release link.
